create_dataset_from_hub: create a Dataset from Hugging Face Hub using repo name, metadata store, revision, and HF token
create_dataset_from_cache: create a Dataset from Hugging Face local cache with optional download and revision
run_dataset_sync_scan: run a synchronous scan on a Dataset with configurable limit, offset, and size limit
run_dataset_sync_index: run a synchronous index on a Dataset with optional file filter and max parallelism
review_dataset_class: review the Dataset class that abstracts reading parquet files with page pruning from Hugging Face Hub or local cache
